note: STC-2 live monitoring probe registry (post-audit Phase 2, 2026-08-21). Read by projects/status-center/monitor/bin/monitor.js. States are computed, never curated: LIVE / DEGRADED / DOWN / NOT_MONITORED. A probe that cannot run reports DOWN or NOT_MONITORED — never silent green.

probes.name: mythosprod.xyz (ecosystem hub)
probes.note: Apex deployed 2026-08-22: the Mythos Hub Dashboard is served from sites/mythosprod.xyz via /var/www/mythosprod.xyz, with TLS for mythosprod.xyz and www. BLOCKER-HUB-DNS is cleared. The probe is unchanged and still expects 200 — a DOWN here now means a real outage of the platform entry point, not a pending deployment.

probes.name: mythosprod.xyz/health.json (Hub dashboard endpoint)
probes.note: Distinct from hub-apex: hub-apex proves the site answers over HTTPS, this proves the dashboard's own health endpoint is served. Both must be green for the entry point to be whole.

probes.name: mythosprod.xyz/api/status.json (Hub status feed)
probes.note: The Hub reads its state through this same-origin alias onto this monitor's own output. The alias points outside the Hub's webroot, so it can break while the Hub itself still answers 200 — without this probe that failure is invisible. Probing our own output is not a loop: the result lands in the next snapshot.

probes.name: SYA catalog API
probes.note: OPERATOR: confirm the real read-only catalog API health path (SYA-API-1), then enable. Shipped disabled rather than guessing an endpoint — NOT_MONITORED is honest, a wrong URL is noise. expect_content_type is REQUIRED here and must stay: ssangyong.autos serves a catch-all/SPA fallback that answers HTTP 200 with the storefront index.html for /api/health and for any nonsense path, so expect_status alone reports LIVE against a dead API (verified on-host 2026-08-22; the API has been down since 2026-08-16).

probes.name: idauto-postgres (database)
probes.note: OPERATOR: idauto-postgres runs under Docker/Coolify and deploy is no longer in the docker group (deliberate, VPS-GATE). Enable only after confirming a host-reachable port or a socket path; otherwise this stays NOT_MONITORED rather than false-DOWN.

probes.name: Off-host backup system
probes.note: Reads the health record written by ops/backup/mythos-backup-run.sh. A missing record is DOWN, never unknown-green.
